description: 'Office Application Spawning Script Interpreter. Evidence basis: l factory reset to wipe the system and remove all malicious files. Avoided restoring from any old "dirty" backups;. CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX Detection Engineering.'
references: []
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX Detection Engineering
date: 2026-07-19
tags:
- attack.t1204.002
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - \outlook.exe
            - \winword.exe
            - \excel.exe
            - \powerpnt.exe
        Image|endswith:
            - \powershell.exe
            - \cmd.exe
            - \wscript.exe
            - \mshta.exe
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative activity
    - Authorized security testing
level: high
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\outlook.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\winword.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\excel.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\powerpnt.exe")
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\cmd.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\wscript.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\mshta.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
splunk: | tstats count from datamodel=Endpoint where nodename=Endpoint.Processes (Processes.parent_process_path="*\outlook.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\winword.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\excel.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\powerpnt.exe") (Processes.process_path="*\powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_path="*\cmd.exe" OR Processes.process_path="*\wscript.exe" OR Processes.process_path="*\mshta.exe") by Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_path _time
osquery: SELECT * FROM processes WHERE (path LIKE '%\powershell.exe' OR path LIKE '%\cmd.exe' OR path LIKE '%\wscript.exe' OR path LIKE '%\mshta.exe');
